prompts.prompt: Use case stylized-concept. Create a polished landscape enemy concept board for CAIRN, a realistic dark sword-and-sorcery side-scrolling beat-em-up, THE ASHEN DEPTHS. Attached image is material and world reference only: black basalt, soot-black iron, heat within ancient war machinery; reduce its overall red saturation, use pale ash and concentrated amber heat. Main 70% of board is a lateral gameplay illustration: human-scale CINDER BEARER on right, hunched undead laborer with a cracked heavy iron furnace strapped into its back, ember light visible between ribs, charred burial wrappings, one arm ending in a short iron rake, other hand throwing a fist-sized glowing physical clinker of slag. On left muscular barbarian with axe in worn leather and fur bats an already landed hot clinker back toward the bearer. Clearly readable ash-dark solid floor and furnace architecture behind it; no lava on fighting lane. Show one thrown clinker and one redirected clinker, restrained spark trails, no UI. Remaining right 30% is elegant charcoal concept panel with title 'CINDER BEARER', subtitle 'Carry the fire. Turn it against them.' Large full-body three-quarter side view of same hunched creature showing backpack furnace, rake-arm, exposed embers through ribs. Bottom row three small clinker studies labeled 'LANDS', 'CRACKS', 'BURSTS': rough black slag lump, increasingly hot internal cracks, compact burst. Naturalistic detailed painted realism, brutal physical medieval foundry horror, warm accents limited to actual heat, strong grounded silhouette, not sci-fi robot, not cartoon, no giant flame hair, no graphic gore. Full feet visible.

Create a polished landscape boss concept board for CAIRN, realistic dark sword-and-sorcery beat-em-up. THE KILN SAINT, final boss of The Ashen Depths. Reference image only for black basalt and riveted ancient furnace iron; use mostly soot black, ash grey and restricted amber heat. Left 70%: lateral gameplay-scale tableau in monumental furnace chapel, sealed iron aperture in rear wall, broad solid matte dark stone fighting floor, chain anchors at edges. Boss at center-right, 2.5 times human height, towering ancient armored executioner tethered by immense heavy chains to rear furnace. Strong broad shoulders, heavy asymmetrical layered black iron armor, featureless oval funeral mask WITHOUT eyes or expression, no horns, long iron furnace rake held at side. Torso a thick iron reliquary with hinged chest shutter opened outward: inside is an unmistakable human-shaped bed of glowing coals, ember ribs and limbs within a cavity, not a sci-fi reactor. Barbarian small at left on same floor with axe and leather/fur, ready to strike a hot clinker toward open chest. Heat visible but no huge fire explosion; full bodies and feet readable. Right 30% elegant charcoal concept panel title 'THE KILN SAINT', subtitle 'The furnace keeps its saint alive.' Large full-body detail same boss with shutter closed and rake clearly visible. Bottom two compact studies: 'OPEN CHEST' cavity with ember figure and open shutter; 'UNBOUND' broken trailing chains, cracked mask and damaged shutter permanently ajar, more aggressive stance. Detailed naturalistic painted dark medieval horror, tactile soot and ash, profound weight, industrial ritual without steampunk gears or modern machinery. No HUD, no excessive orange saturation, no graphic gore.

Create an elegant landscape environment concept art board for CAIRN: THE ASHEN DEPTHS, dark realistic sword-and-sorcery side-scrolling game. Four equal wide panels arranged in a precise 2x2 grid, thin charcoal gutters, understated ivory serif labels in small black footer strips. Each panel a DISTINCT full environment painting with same lateral camera, realistic basalt and soot iron, ash grey midtones, restrained orange heat only at sources, clear solid flat dark fighting floor in lower third from left to right, all architecture behind floor. NO characters, NO enemies, no UI, no lava on fighting floor. Attached cinder image is material reference only; avoid copying identical fortress or all-over red sky. Top-left label '01 / THE ASHFALL ROAD': exposed broad basalt approach beneath dead volcanic slope, pale ash storm under grey sky, distant looming ancient war-furnace complex, broken transport rails behind arena, charred branch lower-left and one loose chain right foreground. Airy wind and exposure. Top-right label '02 / THE FURNACE MOUTH': monumental iron intake gate carved into black mountain, giant shutters and ducts, small amber inspection slots, a vent expelling a restrained puff of smoke and sparks, close iron brace at edge and hanging chains, clear broad service floor. Bottom-left label '03 / THE BLACK CRUCIBLE': cavernous internal furnace works with suspended slag buckets on huge chains, one tilted bucket pouring a thin molten stream into narrow channel BEHIND arena, immense dark vertical space, broken toothed wheel low left corner and low pipe right, broad matte stone floor. Bottom-right label '04 / THE SAINT’S RELIQUARY': vast solemn nearly silent furnace chapel, huge SEALED iron circular aperture in rear wall with a few dim ember seams, empty anchor chains, scorched steps behind wide arena, heavy foreground chains only at lower corners, very few particles, darkest and most ritualistic room. No boss painted into environment. Strong visual progression from open bleak exterior to oppressive interior to solemn final room. Fine naturalistic painting with tactile detail, atmospheric perspective and readable gameplay composition. No giant statues, no modern technology, no text besides exact four labels. Four panels all equally detailed and sufficiently wide; preserve generous clear floor and full left/right traversal.
